info.name: Document search API
info.description: App routes require a signed-in Supabase session. Log in in the browser, copy the `sb-<project>-auth-token` cookie(s) and paste the full Cookie header value into the `authCookie` collection variable. Unauthenticated calls return 401 JSON. The MCP folder is the exception: it uses the `mcpApiKey` variable (server API key), not the session cookie. See docs/MCP.md.

request.description: Member of the chatbot's team. POST /v1/realtime/client_secrets. No OpenAI-Beta header. OpenAI-Safety-Identifier is a hash of the signed-in user. Response: { clientSecret, expiresAt, voice, model }. The session type is realtime, voice marin, Spanish, semantic VAD, and tools buscar_biblioteca, listar_biblioteca, abrir_documento, recordar_perfil, abrir_pantalla, consultar_app, resumen_biblioteca, and colgar. The Realtime tool schema has no async field. 401 without a session, 409 when the assistant has no documents or no search index.
